title: The Ski Bus at the depot stop, slow motion
notes: Block R3. Caption: 'Ski bus stop whisks far away households to the ski area', so the depot (stop, shelter, SKI BUS sign) is in frame with the coach at it. The depot stands in town at (657, 608.7, 553.3), north side of the main east-west road (z about 535), tall buildings around. The coach (SkiCoachBus, one in the city; its id changes on every load: find it with __coach()) arrives westbound on z 540 to 542 at about 25 m/s at sim speed 1, stops at the shelter (x 657 to 661, z 542) for about 4 s, then swings into the depot bay (z up to 549), turns at (656, 535) and leaves east on z 535. Read its Game.Objects.Transform (InterpolatedTransform updates only near the camera). Slow motion: fps target 30, capture 120, campath fps 120: each game second becomes 2 clip seconds in the -x60 clip (a 1 s path gave 121 frames at deltaTime 1/120). Trigger: a page timer polls the coach every 100 ms and starts the sequence when x drops below 705 inbound. Camera: Photo Mode south-east of the stop across the road, 40 mm, a 2 m drift, looking at the shelter. Light: Time of Day 14. Icons: Photo Mode overlay hidden plus the overlay op. Take 7 is the best. Take 6: trigger x < 765 and a wider camera (the coach small and late).

blockR2.title: The Ski Bus driving through town
blockR2.notes: The depot now stands outside town at (657, 608.7, 553.3); the coach (SkiCoachBus, one in the city; its id changes on every load: find it once with __coach()) drives about 4.5 km to the hotel stop near the Grand Lodge. Its road through town is the parallel street, a straight line from about (2510, -1662) to (2852, -1360) (direction (0.75, 0.662)); the coach drives it north-east inbound and south-west outbound, at roughly 15 m/s at sim speed 1, with a stop near (2682, -1504). The scouted 'MediumRoad straight' near the depot was not used: the frame there has no town behind. Camera: a locked Photo Mode camera on the street's south-east verge, 17 m from the road line at 129 m along it (about (2618, 787.2, -1589.4)), 2.3 m above the snow, looking north-west across the street at the shops, 28 mm, a 3 m drift with the traffic. The verge is full of firs; this spot is the one 29 m gap (along 113 to 142 m, offset under 28 m). Light: Photo Mode Time of Day 13 (sun from the south on the coach's side facing the camera). Trigger: poll the coach's InterpolatedTransform every 100 ms at sim speed 1 and start the sequence when its position along the street passes 90 m, driving north-east (it then crosses the frame center about 2 s into the path). Icons and outlines: Photo Mode overlay hidden plus the overlay op. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
